introduction.en: Glass, grain, and colors that follow your sites, your wallpaper or the time of day.
introduction.fr: Du verre, du grain, et des couleurs qui suivent vos sites, votre fond d'écran ou l'heure.

body.en: Pick each Space's material on its window preview in Appearance: Liquid Glass tinted with its color, or a fine film grain.
body.fr: Choisissez la matière de chaque Space sur l'aperçu de sa fenêtre, dans Apparence : du Liquid Glass teinté de sa couleur, ou un grain fin.

notes: Each Space can be made of glass, with Liquid Glass tinted by its color, or of grain, its color under a fine film grain: pick it on the window preview under Appearance, in the Space editor or during setup.

body.en: Take the color of the site you're on or of your wallpaper, or let your color warm up in the evening.
body.fr: Prenez la couleur du site ouvert ou de votre fond d'écran, ou laissez votre couleur se réchauffer le soir.

notes: Each Space can be made of glass, with Liquid Glass tinted by its color, or of grain, its color under a fine film grain: pick it on the window preview under Appearance, in the Space editor or during setup.
